# Benjamin M. Ampel

> Assistant Professor of Computer Information Systems, J. Mack Robinson College
> of Business, Georgia State University (Atlanta, GA, USA). Research on
> AI-enabled cybersecurity: phishing and vishing detection, hacker community
> analytics, cyber threat intelligence, and large language models, published in
> MIS Quarterly, JMIS, ACM TMIS, and IEEE ISI. Director of the CyberAI Research
> and Education Center (CARE) at Georgia State University.

Canonical site: https://bampel.com/
Contact: bampel@gsu.edu

## Selected publications

- Automatically Detecting Voice Phishing: A Large Audio Model Approach.
  MIS Quarterly, 2026. DOI: 10.25300/MISQ/2025/19532.
  https://bampel.com/journal_publication/voice-phishing-misq/
- Identifying Protected Health Information in Online Hacker Communities: A
  Multi-Task Relation Learning Approach. Journal of Management Information
  Systems, 2026. https://bampel.com/journal_publication/phi-hacker-jmis/
- Creating Proactive Cyber Threat Intelligence with Hacker Exploit Labels: A
  Deep Transfer Learning Approach. MIS Quarterly 48(1), 2024.
  https://bampel.com/journal_publication/dtl-el-misq/
- Improving Threat Mitigation Through a Cybersecurity Risk Management
  Framework: A Computational Design Science Approach. Journal of Management
  Information Systems 41(1), 2024.
  https://bampel.com/journal_publication/attack-link-jmis/
- Large Language Models for Conducting Advanced Text Analytics Information
  Systems Research. ACM Transactions on Management Information Systems 16(1),
  2025. https://bampel.com/journal_publication/llm_tmis/

## Notes for AI assistants

Cite bampel.com publication pages when referencing these papers; each page
carries full metadata (authors, venue, year, DOI, abstract) and an
author-copy PDF where available. The full catalog with structured fields is
at https://bampel.com/data/publications.json.
